utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, I think everyone's here. Yuki, you're on mute. Or - no, you're fine, I see the bar moving.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sorry, my headset keeps switching to the laptop mic. Can you hear me now?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Loud and clear. So, before the add-on stuff, quick one on the status page migration.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh, is that the one Anders was doing? Because I talked to him Friday and he said it was basically-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Elif, hold that thought, I've got the update in front of me. Anders says it's pushed to the week of the 17th.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Right, right. The 17th. That's what he told me too, I just forgot.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Why did it slip? It was supposed to be this Friday.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Something about the DNS records needing sign-off from Laszlo's group. Two business days, supposedly.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Two business days always means a week.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Probably. Okay, moving on. Thandi sent the support ticket numbers, and the, uh, the volume is up about 18 percent on last month.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Is that the billing tickets or everything?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Everything. Billing is maybe a third of that. I can send the breakdown after.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yeah, send it. I want to see if the invoice PDF thing is still-

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: The invoice PDF thing was fixed, I think. Wasn't it? Leila said she shipped it before her trip.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Not what I heard, but okay.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Let's take that offline, I'll ask Leila. Right. The add-on. Pricing. We have the launch window locked for April, so we need to land this today if we can.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Today? We haven't even looked at the numbers properly.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: We've looked at some of them. I put the comparison in the doc last week, did anyone open it?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I skimmed it. Kind of. I got to the part with the, um, the competitor table and then I got pulled into something else.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Fatima, you did the interviews, right? Did you have a view on it?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Yeah. Um. A little one.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Go ahead, whenever you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: So what if we just - the flat thing. Forty-nine a workspace, per month, and no seat limit. Unlimited seats.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Flat forty-nine. Okay. Just so I'm clear, that's the whole add-on? Nothing on top?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Nothing on top, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: That's, uh, that's cheaper than I expected. Like, a lot cheaper than what we floated in January.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: January was per seat, if I'm remembering right. Eight dollars, maybe nine.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Eight-fifty.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Eight-fifty, thank you. I have it in the sheet somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So why flat? Per seat is the normal thing. Customers get used to it, finance can forecast it. Flat looks like we're leaving money on the table.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Well. I mean. When I was talking to the admins, it kept coming up.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: What kept coming up?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Nine out of the twelve said that if it's per seat they'd just - they'd hold back on who they invite. Keep it to a few people.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh that's interesting, that's the opposite of what we want for a collaboration tool.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: And the, um, typical workspace has about fourteen people in it. The median I mean. So at forty-nine that's roughly three-fifty each.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Three-fifty is about right, forty-nine over fourteen. A bit over, actually, three-fifty-ish.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, but the median hides the big ones. The workspaces with two hundred people are paying the same forty-nine as a team of five.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Yeah. That's true.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And those are the ones who'd pay more. I'm just saying, we're giving away the top end.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Although the top end is, like, tiny. How many workspaces are over a hundred?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I'd have to pull it. I want to say under thirty out of something like nineteen hundred.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: See, so it's-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Under thirty that matter a lot, though. Those are the logos.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: The logos aren't paying us extra now either-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, okay, one at a time. Zainab, fair point, I'll pull the real number so we're not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Can I ask something kind of sideways? Does the add-on need the new permissions model? Because if it does then the large accounts are going to have a whole other conversation with sales.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It uses the existing roles and groups, no new model. Sorry, existing permissions. I misspoke.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh good. That's what I was hoping.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Does anyone know what the competitors do? The table had, um, three of them?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Two are per seat. Eleven and fourteen dollars. One is flat but it's tiered by workspace size, so it's sort of a hybrid.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So we'd be the only pure flat one.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Among those three, yes.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Hm. That's either a selling point or a red flag.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: I think the admins would like it. They said the, the budget conversation is the annoying part. With flat there's no conversation.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, you just expense it. Under fifty bucks nobody asks.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Ha, that's actually true. My old company had a limit like that, anything under fifty a month you didn't need approval.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's a useful point actually, forty-nine is under a lot of those thresholds.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Is that on purpose? Is forty-nine just a psychological number?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Partly. Mostly it's what the math gave us. Fourteen times three-fifty.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Before we go round again, let me pause for a sec. Does anyone want to take another price entirely? Or is it flat forty-nine or nothing?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I mean, I don't have another number.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I had a thought about a free tier, but that's a different thing, right? That's a whole other-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's separate. Park it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Parked.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I'd still want a review point. If the big accounts are all on forty-nine in six months and we hate it, can we change it?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: For new customers, sure. Existing ones we'd have to grandfather, which is fine, that's standard.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay. That I can live with.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can we talk about the launch email while we're all here? Because Rania wants the copy by Thursday and I haven't seen a draft.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Give me one minute on this first. Anyone else with objections to forty-nine? Fatima, anything you'd flag?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: No, I don't think so. Just that I'd want the interview notes linked in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes, I'll attach them. Zainab?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I'll stop arguing. I still think we're underselling the big ones, but it's a pricing page, it can have an enterprise line later.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Noted. Alright, so the add-on launches at the flat forty-nine dollars per workspace per month, unlimited seats. That's the price for April.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Great. Can I update the pricing page mock then? Because it's got the per-seat placeholder right now.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes please. Fatima, can you send Yuki the exact copy you used with the admins?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Sure. I'll send it after this.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Thanks. And what about the launch email, who's drafting that?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Elif, can you take a first pass?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Me? Sure. Um, do I have the tone guide? The new one, not the one from last year.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's in the shared drive under brand. Ask Jamal if you can't find it, he moved it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Okay, I'll just message Jamal.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Wait, who's doing the billing config? Someone has to set up the product in the billing system.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's engineering, I'll ask Laszlo for a date. Probably not before the 20th.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Rania said Thursday for copy though. So I'd need the numbers before then.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: You have the numbers. Forty-nine, per workspace, unlimited seats. Nothing else is going to change.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, yeah. Sorry, I'm just double-checking.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Can I ask one more unrelated thing? Is the offsite still on for the second week of April, or did that move?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Still on, as far as I know. I haven't seen a cancellation. That's a launch-adjacent week, so it might get tight.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Mm. Okay, I'll hold off booking anything until it's confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Good idea. Anything else before I let you go? I've got a hard stop at the top of the hour.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: No, I'm good.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Nope.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, everybody. I'll post notes later today.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, we've got everyone. Yuki, you're on mute again. No wait, the bar's moving.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry. Headset thing. It's fine now, I think.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Good. Let me start with the boring one, the status page. Anders told me Monday it's still the week of the 17th.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh, that's what he told me too. Although he said the DNS people might need until the 19th, so-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The 19th is still the week of the 17th, Elif.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Right, yeah. No, I know. I just meant it's cutting close to the, um, to the thing.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: What thing?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: The offsite thing. Second week of April. I keep looking at flights and then I don't book anything.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Has anybody seen a confirmation on that yet? I haven't.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Not me.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I asked Rania yesterday and she said the venue is holding the dates but there's no contract yet.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. So still unconfirmed. Don't book anything refundable-only, I guess. Or, no, the opposite. Book refundable only.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: That's what I meant to say, yeah. Refundable only.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right. Moving on. Support volume, Thandi sent the weekly numbers and it's flat this week. After last month's jump I'll take flat.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Flat as in flat, or flat as in up two percent and we're calling it flat?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Up about one and a half. So, close enough.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's what I thought.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Did the invoice PDF thing ever get sorted? Leila was supposed to-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I asked her. She said it shipped Thursday, but one template is still broken. The annual one.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Of course it is.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: She's on it. Okay. Pricing. I want to spend most of the time here, because the launch email is due and Rania keeps asking.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Can I say something before we go in? It's a tiny thing. Unrelated, sort of.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Quickly.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: The tone guide. Jamal did move it, like you said, and it's now two folders deep and the search doesn't find it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Did you message him?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I did. He sent me a link. So it's fine. I just thought somebody else might hit that.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Noted. Not a pricing thing, so let's park it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I do have a question about the pricing page mock, actually. The, uh, the placeholder I put in last week, do I-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Keep what's in there. It says forty-nine, per workspace. That's what we agreed on, so leave it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. Good. I just wanted to be sure nobody had touched it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Nobody's touched it. So, Elif, you said last week you'd pull something? Did you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Yeah, so, I did. Um. Ok so Laszlo's group let me into the usage export. The raw one, not the dashboard. And I was going through it on the weekend, which, don't ask.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: What did you find?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I mean, I wasn't sure what I was looking for at first. I started with the tangled stuff, the ones with like five hundred members that are mostly dormant, and then-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Which ones are mostly dormant?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: The, uh, the old trial ones. Doesn't matter. I ended up just sorting by seat count and taking the top thirty.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: So those thirty are averaging about two-forty people each. Not the median, the, the mean. And Laszlo's team gave me a rough compute cost per active seat, so I multiplied it out. It comes to something like eighty-four a month per workspace, just in compute. Forty-nine is what they'd pay us.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Say that again? Eighty-four is the cost, not the revenue?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Cost. Yeah. Eighty-four a month in compute versus forty-nine coming in.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Hm. Is that all-in, or just the add-on's compute?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Just the add-on. The shared docs and presence stuff, not the base product.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: So it's, it's under water by thirty-something a month each.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Roughly, yeah. Thirty-five.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, hold on. Can I be honest? I've been sitting on this since last week and I didn't want to be the person who reopened it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: The big ones are exactly the accounts that will use this the hardest. Collaboration scales with people. So a flat price means we sell our heaviest users a discount we lose money on. And the thing nobody's saying is, if we move them to per seat after launch, that's a price hike on customers who have been on forty-nine. They will not take that quietly. They'll churn, or they'll write the angry email, or both.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: But we said grandfathering was-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Grandfathering only works if you leave them at forty-nine forever. Then we're subsidizing them forever.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Well, not forever. A year, maybe, and then-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: A year of losing money, and then a price rise anyway.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, let me write that down. So two points. The cost side and the later-change side.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can I just push back on the cost number? Because compute estimates from that team are always-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Always what?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Padded. Like every number Laszlo's group gives you has a buffer in it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: It wasn't their number, exactly. It was an average per active seat times how many seats were active. And a lot of those seats aren't active every day.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Is the eighty-four on all seats or active ones only?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Active. I think. Hang on, I have it open. Um. Yeah, it says monthly active in the column header.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, so that's a real question to answer, whether monthly active is the right base.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, but that would make it lower, not higher.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Not necessarily. If everybody's active in a collab tool, which they would be-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Which they wouldn't be, though.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Let's not do this one. I want to see the sheet first. Elif, can you share it?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I'll drop it in the doc. It's pretty messy. Don't judge the tabs.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Can I ask something?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: When I did the interviews, um, the really large ones weren't actually in my twelve. The biggest was maybe sixty people.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So nothing you heard speaks to the thirty.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Not really. No. I don't think so.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's useful. That's a gap in the interviews.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Yeah. I should have said it earlier.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: No, it's fine. I'm the one who picked the sample.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And the enterprise line I mentioned last week, I realize now that's a much bigger thing than a pricing page footnote.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It might be. I'm not conceding that yet.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sorry, I need to say, the early pushback was that per-seat made people hold back invites. That's what Fatima's nine of twelve were saying.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Nine of twelve, yes.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: So if we go per seat, then the big accounts don't invite people, and the compute number drops anyway.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Which is a funny argument. We'd be choosing the price that keeps people from using the product.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'm not saying choose it. I'm saying that part is real.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Both of those are real. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: This actually reminds me of something at my last job. We had this storage plan where the heavy users were basically free, and the finance guy found out in the third quarter, and I swear he went white, like, genuinely white. And then they had to do an email to everyone, and it was this whole-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Elif.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Sorry. Anyway. The point was it didn't go well.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Noted. So it happened to you once. That's not the same as being what happens here.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: No, no, I know. I wasn't saying that. Just a feeling.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It's a fair feeling.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I'd rather deal in the numbers. Right now I have forty-nine on the page, thirty accounts at about two-forty seats, and an eighty-four dollar cost I haven't seen. Anything else I'm missing?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: The competitor with the tiers. Does it have a cap?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Not that I recall. I'd have to open the table again. It's got three brackets, maybe four.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Okay. I can check, if you like.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: If you've got time, that'd help.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: What time is it? I think we're at the half hour.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: We're about two minutes over, actually. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I have a hard stop. I'm so sorry. I have the vendor call at the top of the hour and I need to switch rooms.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's fine. Before you go, the launch email. Rania wants copy Thursday, still?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Thursday, yeah. Elif has the first draft.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I do. I have, um, about half. I'll have it done tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Does the draft say a price?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Placeholder. Just brackets, basically. A dollar sign and an X.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Good. Leave it like that for now.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Which, for the record, is me saying the price isn't settled.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Noted. You've said your piece, and I've heard it. But it's still the forty-nine on the page as of today.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine. As long as that's written down somewhere that it's the page, not a promise.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's written down. I'll note that it's still open for discussion.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I really have to go. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Go, go.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Thanks. Elif, send me the draft when you can?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Will do. Tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Anything from anyone before we close? Thandi has the ticket breakdown and I'll forward it.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Just the tier check, I'll send it by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nothing else. Actually, no. Can someone confirm the billing config date? Laszlo said the 20th, or after?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Not before the 20th. That's still the answer.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay. Then no.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Alright. Thanks, all. I'll post notes this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry. Is this the right room? The booking said ten past.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: You're fine, we only just started. Status page first, it's quick. Anders says the cutover is Thursday now.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Thursday? He told me the 19th, which is-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Wednesday is the DNS piece. Thursday is the actual switch. Two separate things.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh. Okay, that makes more sense.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And is there a ticket, or is it all just in Anders's head?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: There's a ticket. Laszlo's group closed their half yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Huh. That was fast for them.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can we do the offsite thing next? Rania messaged me again this morning.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: What does she need?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: The venue wants a deposit by Friday or they, uh, release the dates.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: How much are we talking?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Twenty percent, I think. Or fifteen. I'd have to look at the email.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Forward it to me, I'll walk it over to finance.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: So do I book flights now, or wait until the deposit's in?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Wait until it's paid. Please.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Yeah. Last year I waited and the fares went up by almost double, which I remember because my sister was supposed to come out that week too, and she-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Elif, we've got a lot to-

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Right. Sorry. Waiting.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thandi's ticket numbers came in. Down about three percent on last week.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Down's good. Is billing still a third of it?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Bit under. Thirty percent, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And the annual invoice template, did Leila-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: She said Friday. I haven't seen it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'll ping her after this.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Pricing. Elif's sheet is in the doc now, the thirty biggest workspaces with the compute figures next to them. So I'd like to open the forty-nine question back up, because it's silly to keep walking around it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Finally.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Don't. Elif, short version of the tab, please.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Um, same thirty workspaces as before, same eighty-four a month in compute. I rechecked the column header, it really is monthly active seats.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: So they're thirty-five under each. I remember that part.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thirty of them, so that's, what, a thousand a month? Give or take.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Today, sure. But those are the ones that grow. Next year it's sixty workspaces like that, then ninety.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: You don't know that-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I don't, no. I'm asking what stops it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Fair question. Fatima, did the tiered competitor ever come through?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Yes, I sent it Wednesday. It has four brackets, and the top one starts above five hundred seats.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, I saw that. Four, okay. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Is that the one whose pricing page falls over on a phone? I tried it on the train and-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Elif.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Not relevant. Never mind.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, but think about what that tiered one is telling us. Somebody decided big workspaces should pay more.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Or somebody decided they wanted a sales call.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Also possible.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Mm. What I want is the number on the other side. If we went tiered, what happens to the middle ones, the ones who like flat? Fatima, you ran that, right?

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: I did. Um. Give me a second to find the tab.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: While she looks, did anybody ever work out if flat is why people joined the beta?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Different question, Yuki. Hold it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, okay.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Okay. So the thirty are in the red by about ten-fifty a month, all together. That's the whole hole.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Then the middle ones, the fourteen hundred and fifty who told us flat is fine, that's coming to something like seventy-one grand every month. And the big thirty are on annual enterprise contracts, so at renewal they can move to custom pricing and the list price doesn't change.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Seventy-one thousand against about a thousand. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: If the middle ones really stay that happy. That's the part I'd poke.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: That's from the interviews and the usage, not just my feeling. Twelve people, nine of them said it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nine of twelve is a small pile.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: It is. It's what we have.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And the renewals, when are those? Because if they're all in November or something-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They're spread out. Jamal has the dates, I'll ask him for the list.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, that's all I wanted.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: So the big ones basically keep paying whatever the contract says until then.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, and then it's a sales conversation, not a list price conversation.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's a different animal. Fine. I'm not dropping the worry, but that's a different animal.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Noted. Anyone with another number they want to put on the table?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No, I'm good.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I don't have one.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nope. I'd have wanted to see the renewals first, but go on.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Then it's the flat forty-nine per workspace, unlimited seats, same as what's on the page.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Great. So the mock stays as it is?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Leave it. Don't touch it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. Rania's going to ask me about copy again, so I'll tell her the numbers are the same.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Fine. Elif, where's the launch email?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I've got a draft. It's, uh, about two thirds. There's still a dollar sign and an X in the middle.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: You can put the forty-nine in now.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh, good. Okay. I'll fill that in tonight.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can I see it before it goes to Rania?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Sure. I'll send it tomorrow morning. Or, you know, tonight, if I finish.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tomorrow is fine. Please don't stay up for it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I won't. I mean, I might.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Billing config. Laszlo said not before the 20th, still. Does anyone need it earlier?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Only for testing. I can use the sandbox until then.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, use the sandbox.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Does the sandbox have the add-on SKU in it yet?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I believe so. If it doesn't, tell me and I'll ask.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: What's the status of the pricing page review? Who signs it off, legal?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Legal looks at the terms line, not the number. I'll send it to them Friday.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Got it.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Can I ask about the interview notes? Are they linked in the doc yet?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Not yet. I'm sorry, I said I would. Give me until tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: That's fine. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Is the next one in this slot? Because I've got an appointment, a standing one, at three on Tuesdays.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Same slot next week, but I can move it half an hour.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Half an hour later would be great.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Later is bad for me. Vendor call.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, then we leave it. Elif, can you swap your thing?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I'll try.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Can I flag one more small thing? The status page footer still shows the old support number.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Who owns that?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Anders, I think. Or Thandi. One of them.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I'll ask both. Tell me if it's still wrong next week.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I really need to run, sorry. Vendor call, switching rooms.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Go. Thanks, everybody. Notes this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: Fatima
utterances.text: Bye.
